improvement_detail: against direct numpy simulation (O(L t)); asymptotically O(L log L log t) vs O(L t); indicative timings on a shared machine
novelty_basis: Standard for linear CA (Martin-Odlyzko-Wolfram 1984); the benchmark is ours.
statement: Computing the row at time t of an affine magma automaton by binary exponentiation of P = a + bS modulo S^L - 1 (FFT products) is exact and, at L = 1024, about 3-4x faster than direct numpy simulation at t = 100, 22-29x at 10^3, 138-215x at 10^4 and 1800-2500x at 10^5; t = 10^9 takes 1.5-8 ms for L <= 4096.
title: Affine fast-forward by operator powers
